title: Finger Exercise 16 — flatten
statement:
Implement `flatten(L)` using **recursion**.

- `L`: a (possibly deeply) nested list.
- Return a new **flat** list containing every non-list element of `L`, in left-to-right order, at every depth.

```
flatten([[1, 4, [6], 2], [[[3]], 2], 4, 5]) -> [1, 4, 6, 2, 3, 2, 4, 5]
```
